column1: # The practice tools the packing script puts in the app: PracticeROM's sloperinaGZ (https://github.com/PracticeROM/sloperina, GPL-3.0), its official release, pinned by the
# SHA-256 of its zip (the game's note, "Practice tools"). scripts/build_app.py takes the zip from <build folder>/practice/, or downloads it from url there, and refuses one with
# other bytes. From it: the module, which patch_nso.py rewrites; of the patches folder the IPS whose name is main's build ID, which the host checks applies; the license.
# A new release is new rows here, and the game played with it again.
